answer: At registration, group keys by the on-chain address funding their fee. Propose a 0.1 POA base charge plus 0.05 POA for each earlier key funded by that address; reject underpayment. The contract increments the source count after every registration. For 1,000 fakes from one source: 1,000 × 0.1 + 0.05 × (0 + … + 999) = 25,075 POA; one honest key pays 0.1 POA once. Naming keys opal, fable, or ferrous cannot reset the source count. This deters a shared treasury, not attackers using many funders.
